# Technical Implementation Plan

## 1. Necessary npm Libraries to Install

- [ ] **react-markdown** — For rendering markdown content.
- [ ] **react-slate** or **@tiptap/react** or **slate** — For rich text editing with slash commands (choose one based on preference; Tiptap or Slate are popular).
- [ ] **@fortawesome/react-fontawesome** — For icons (optional, for sidebar and callouts).
- [ ] **classnames** — For conditional styling.
- [ ] **uuid** — For generating unique IDs for pages/subpages.
- [ ] **react-treeview** or **rc-tree** — For rendering the sidebar tree structure (optional, can implement manually).
- [ ] **react-hotkeys** — For keyboard shortcuts (optional, for slash commands).

## 2. New Component Files to Create

- [ ] **src/components/Sidebar/SidebarTree.tsx**
  - Purpose: Renders the left sidebar with pages/subpages in a tree structure. Handles page selection and tree expansion/collapse.
- [ ] **src/components/Editor/MarkdownEditor.tsx**
  - Purpose: Main markdown editor with slash commands for H1–H3, bullets, and callouts.
- [ ] **src/components/Sidebar/PageNode.tsx**
  - Purpose: Represents a single page node (with possible children) in the sidebar tree.
- [ ] **src/components/Editor/SlashCommandMenu.tsx**
  - Purpose: Displays slash command menu when user types `/` in the editor.
- [ ] **src/components/Callout/CalloutBlock.tsx**
  - Purpose: Custom block for callouts in the markdown editor.
- [ ] **src/context/PageContext.tsx**
  - Purpose: Manages the state of pages/subpages, selected page, and page content.
- [ ] **src/App.tsx**
  - Purpose: Main app layout combining sidebar and editor.

## 3. Files That Need Modification

- [ ] **src/App.tsx**
  - Integrate SidebarTree and MarkdownEditor components.
  - Set up layout (flex: sidebar left, editor right).
- [ ] **src/index.tsx**
  - Ensure proper app rendering and context provider wrapping.
- [ ] **src/styles/global.css** (or similar)
  - Add styles for sidebar, editor, slash command menu, and callouts.

---

## Summary Checklist

### Libraries
- [ ] react-markdown
- [ ] react-slate / @tiptap/react / slate
- [ ] @fortawesome/react-fontawesome
- [ ] classnames
- [ ] uuid
- [ ] react-treeview / rc-tree
- [ ] react-hotkeys

### Components
- [ ] SidebarTree.tsx
- [ ] PageNode.tsx
- [ ] MarkdownEditor.tsx
- [ ] SlashCommandMenu.tsx
- [ ] CalloutBlock.tsx
- [ ] PageContext.tsx
- [ ] App.tsx

### Modifications
- [ ] App.tsx
- [ ] index.tsx
- [ ] global.css

---

**Next Steps:**  
Once these items are checked off, you will have the foundation for a Notion-style app with a sidebar tree and markdown editor with slash commands.
